_doc: Claude Code token budget for this project. Counted weighted tokens = input + cache_creation + output + cache_read_weight * cache_read. Budget = weekly_cap_tokens * project_share. weekly_cap_tokens is an ESTIMATE measured from the local transcripts: weighted usage from the first transcript (2026-10-27T13:22Z) to the first weekly-limit error (2026-10-28T13:07:59Z); transcripts before 10-27 no longer exist, so the real cap is at least this value.
